name: Coloborhynchus
isnote: Recovered in Anhangueridae or Ornithocheiridae depending on the analysis.
sum: Large-crested anhanguerian from the Early Cretaceous of England, with front teeth set high on the blunt snout tip.
wsnote: Based on the largest referred material, total skull length could reach 75 cm and wingspan about 7 m; species content varies between authors.
holotype: BMNH 1822 — partial snout, Hastings Beds (Wealden Group), East Sussex, England.
material: Partial snouts and jaw fragments; species assigned to the genus differ among authors.
biology: Fish-eater with a crested, blunt snout and widely spaced fangs suited to seizing prey near the water surface.
author: Owen 1874
